subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors.
stimulus: Like the people of all professions, a teacher has got some duties to perform daily. He gets up early in the morning and does his homework. (a) ______ he takes academic preparation. If he is an English teacher, he reads the text very well and makes notes on important matters. (b) ______ it is time for school, he starts for the school. In the classroom he tries his best to present everything in a lucid and simple English. (c) ______ he supplies notes to the students. (d) ______ the off time he reads English newspaper, magazines etc. At school he does various works and spends a busy time. At night he again reads books and takes a good preparation. (e) ______ a teacher passes his daily life.
guide_solution: (a) after that (b) when (c) sometimes (d) during (e) thus
